context: Use explicit normalized alias handling rather than a bare auth/key substring; make the public anonymizer consume the shared classifier, then drive both actual export layers with sentinels and non-secret tuning/path guards.
description: sanitize_platform_options currently redacts password/token/key families but leaves common credential aliases passwd, pwd, and pat verbatim. A driven ResultExporter(anonymize=False) payload contained PASSWD_SECRET, PWD_SECRET, and PAT_SECRET in platform.raw_config, while the public anonymizer shares the same secret classification. Cover both internal and public result boundaries without substring-redacting legitimate tuning keys such as sort_key, partition_key, or path.

preserves.behavior: nested mapping and tuple sanitization behavior
sort_key, partition_key, primary_key, path, and other tuning values

verifications.command: PYTHONPATH=. uv run --all-extras -- python -c 'from benchbox.core.results.platform_options import sanitize_platform_options; out=sanitize_platform_options({"passwd":"PASSWD_SECRET","pwd":"PWD_SECRET","pat":"PAT_SECRET","sort_key":"o_orderkey","partition_key":"id","path":"/tmp/data","threads":4}); assert all(out[k]=="<redacted>" for k in ("passwd","pwd","pat")) and out["sort_key"]=="o_orderkey" and out["partition_key"]=="id" and out["path"]=="/tmp/data"
verifications.description: internal credential aliases are redacted while tuning keys and paths remain visible
verifications.expected: exits 1 on an unfixed tree because aliases survive; exits 0 after the explicit shared-classifier fix

verifications.command: PYTHONPATH=. uv run --all-extras -- python -c 'import json; from benchbox.core.results.anonymization import AnonymizationManager; out=AnonymizationManager().anonymize_result_payload({"platform_metadata":{"platform_raw_config":{"passwd":"PASSWD_SECRET","pwd":"PWD_SECRET","pat":"PAT_SECRET","path":"/tmp/data","sort_key":"o_orderkey"}}}); text=json.dumps(out); assert all(s not in text for s in ("PASSWD_SECRET","PWD_SECRET","PAT_SECRET")); public=out["platform_metadata"]["platform_raw_config"]; assert public["path"].startswith("path_") and public["sort_key"]=="o_orderkey"'
verifications.description: public anonymizer redacts aliases while applying the existing path hash contract
verifications.expected: exits 1 on an unfixed tree because the public layer misses aliases; exits 0 after the shared-classifier fix

verifications.description: platform option and public anonymization regressions remain green
verifications.expected: passes before and after as a regression guard

work_units.summary: Re-drive credential aliases through internal and public boundaries
Add exact alias classification and shared public-layer coverage
Run platform option and anonymization regressions
